summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Principal Quality ETF (PSET) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund utilizes a proprietary quantitative model to actively invest in large- and mid-cap companies that are perceived to exhibit higher quality, growth potential, and pricing power. PSET was launched on Mar 21, 2016 and is issued by Principal.

holdings.infoBox: PSET is an equity ETF with a total of 73 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 6.98%, Apple at 6.22%, Microsoft at 4.38%, Alphabet at 4.13%, and Palo Alto Networks at 2.79%.
